donohue-2008-tracking-spans.citation: Donohue, Hamilton, Leben, Watts and Waddell (2008), Survey of Deepwater Currents in the Northwestern Gulf of Mexico, Volume II: Technical Report, OCS Study MMS 2008-031, June 2008.
donohue-2008-tracking-spans.access: Original report SHA verified in the retained acquisition. Actual methods page 125, table page 140 and endpoint-figure page 141 reviewed. Seventeen Lifespan-column values transcribed and checked against the paired source dates; U2 excluded because its table and figure disagree.

records.period_label: Source tracking endpoints 1993-07-11 to 1994-01-05; not verified physical birth or death.
records.case_label: Whopper source-defined altimetry track; registry physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: Table 3.1-2, printed page 3-32 / PDF page 140; last-trackable-date Figure 3.1-22, printed page 3-33 / PDF page 141; tracking method section 3.1.5, printed page 3-17 / PDF page 125.
records.definition: Source-reported elapsed days from its labeled Loop Current separation to the last date the named circulation path could be tracked in SSH-anomaly maps.
records.scope: Named source track through the western Gulf of Mexico. For Xtra, Juggernaut and Ulysses, the source name follows the southern branch after splitting and retains the pre-split interval.
records.qualification: Source Lifespan-column value matches calendar subtraction of the source endpoints. The tracking contour is adaptive and requires manual assistance; this is not proof of physical lifetime, material coherence or complete daily sampling. Source SSH anomalies use GSFC00.1_MSS. Source separation and termination labels remain separate from registry initial dates and month-resolution dissipation. No parent span is assigned to a secondary. U2 and author-created unjoined northern labels are excluded. No depth, width, volume, annual envelope, physical footprint, state join or ranking inferred.
